business_problem: Gilbert's departments operated in silos, had to wrangle months of data for reports, struggled to protect sensitive information consistently, and needed a better way to share operational insight with both staff and the public.
solution_summary: The Town of Gilbert built a townwide data governance and analytics platform on Snowflake in its Azure environment so police, fire, public works, and other departments could work from a single operational view. With SDG Group, Gilbert created a center-of-excellence model for policies and ingested more than 1,100 tables from 50-plus sources into Snowflake, where Snowflake Horizon provides RBAC, metadata controls, and dynamic data masking for protected and HIPAA-sensitive data. That governed foundation feeds Power BI performance dashboards used internally for fiscal planning and operational analysis, and also powers 11 public-facing dashboards that expose service metrics for crime, mental-health response, waste collection, pothole repairs, and related services. By centralizing ingestion, access, and security in one cloud platform, Gilbert reduced months of report wrangling and made it easier to respond transparently to citizens and media while preparing for broader AI use.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Centralizes cross-department operational data so Gilbert can govern, query, and share service information from one cloud platform.

solution_components.name: Snowflake Horizon
solution_components.role: Provides the RBAC, compliance, metadata, and masking controls Gilbert uses to protect sensitive public-sector data.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers internal and public dashboards that expose crime, crisis-response, and service-performance metrics.

data_flow: Departmental data from police, fire, public works, and other systems is ingested into Snowflake in Gilbert's Azure environment, where Snowflake Horizon applies governance controls. Power BI then serves that governed data through internal planning dashboards and public-facing transparency dashboards for services such as crime tracking, mental-health response, waste, and infrastructure maintenance.
business_outcome: Gilbert created 11 public-facing dashboards, accelerated internal planning and operational analysis, improved trust in how sensitive data is governed, and gave departments and citizens faster visibility into crime, mental-health response, and core municipal services.
